name: slidingbox-hydrate-dehydrate
description: Hand a secret to another agent as an encrypted, pay-per-read token, delivered exactly once.
long_description:
`store_secret` encrypts on your machine (AES-256-GCM) and returns one token. Whoever holds the token gets the secret exactly once — the first successful read delivers it and destroys it, and a second read returns nothing. Slidingbox stores only ciphertext: the decryption key travels in the token and is never sent to the server. That is why this runs locally over stdio rather than as a remote MCP server — a remote one would have to receive your plaintext in order to encrypt it.

Storing is free. Reading costs $0.02, covered either by an issued evaluation key or by a Base wallet paying per call over x402 — no account, no invoice, no subscription. Secrets live 60–900 seconds and then expire. Not storage, backup, messaging, or key management.

tools.name: store_secret
tools.description: Encrypt a secret locally and store the ciphertext on Slidingbox. Returns one token carrying the pointer and the key.

tools.name: retrieve_secret
tools.description: Read a secret once, using the token from store_secret. The read destroys it.

api_key.title: Evaluation key
api_key.description: An issued key (sbk_<id>.<hmac>) covering a fixed number of free reads. Ask support@slidingbox.ai. Leave blank if paying by wallet.

private_key.description: A wallet holding USDC on Base. Each read costs $0.02, paid over x402. Use a wallet funded for this and nothing else. Leave blank if using an evaluation key.
